title: Himinbjörg – system health
intro: Health of Vardr services from metrics (Prometheus), refreshed every 30 s. Detailed charts and alerts – Grafana links below.
notConfigured: siem-api has no Prometheus address (SIEM_PROMETHEUS_URL) – system health is unavailable.

grafana.pipelineHint: throughput, queues, delays, CPU and memory of services
grafana.firingHint: what is alerting in Grafana right now

archive.disk_free: Free space on the archive disk

server.disk_free: Free space on the system disk

up.ingest: Agents buffer events locally; check `docker compose logs ingest`.
up.normalizer: Batches wait in the SIEM_RAW queue; check the normalizer logs.
up.writer: Events wait in the SIEM_EVENTS queue; check the writer and ClickHouse logs.
up.archiver: Batches wait in the queue; once it is full, the server stops accepting events.
up.detector: Rules are not evaluated – attacks will not raise alerts; check the detector logs.
up.clickhouse: Search and the query engine do not work; the writer keeps retrying.

pipeline.throttled: The queue is full – one of the stages cannot keep up. Check queue fill below.
pipeline.queue: The queue consumer (in brackets) cannot keep up. Above 80% ingest starts rejecting batches.
pipeline.write_errors: The writer keeps retrying; check the writer logs and ClickHouse health.
pipeline.quarantine: Events that could not be normalized or written – they are in siem.quarantine.
pipeline.unreadable: Batches the normalizer could not read (corrupted gzip or JSON) – their events are not searchable, the original is in the NIS2 archive. Details in the normalizer logs (unreadable batch).

detection.rules: The detector has no enabled rules – check the rules directory and the panel.
detection.rule_errors: Some rules do not work – details in the panel (Detection rules) and the detector logs.
detection.index_lag: The query engine checkpoint is stuck – check the detector logs and ClickHouse load.

archive.integrity: Archive data was modified, removed or added outside the archiver – details: panel → Urd.
archive.last_verify: Verification should run every 6 h – check the archiver logs.
archive.enabled: Archiving is disabled by the policy or paused for lack of space – panel → Urd.
archive.disk_free: When the disk fills up, archiving pauses – enlarge the disk or shorten retention.
archive.offsite: Closed archive hours do not reach the S3 bucket – check the archiver logs (archive copy) and access to the storage.

backup.last: A backup should be made every night (cron 02:15, backup.sh) – check ~/siem-lab/backup.log.
backup.remote: Backups do not leave the VM – check the NAS connection and the backup SSH key.

server.disk_free: Running out of space stops ClickHouse and the queues – remove old data or enlarge the disk.
server.cpu: Sustained high load – the pipeline may fall behind at peak event rates.
server.memory: Low memory – the system may kill services (OOM).

monitoring.prometheus: The panel has no source of service health – check the prometheus container ({{error}}).

value.bucket: bucket without Object Lock or unreachable
